You speak to me with great courage.
I prefer truth to false hopes.
Your honesty is entirely admirable.
Thank you for listening to reality, Jean.

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis').

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 'dé-'/'des-' (from Latin 'dis-'/'de-') marks reversal, removal, or separation. Core French verb meaning 'to drop off, to deposit'.

examples.text: Tu peux me déposer au tournage? C'est sur la route.

examples.text: Qui a déposé ces affaires ici?
